description: This file defines a PHP class C128BObject for rendering Code 128-B barcodes using the GD library. It includes class methods for constructing the barcode object, calculating sizes, drawing bars, and rendering the barcode with optional text.

classes.name: C128BObject
classes.description: A class that generates Code 128-B barcodes with given dimensions, style, and value, capable of rendering itself on a graphics canvas.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the barcode object with width, height, style, and value, and sets internal character sets and mappings.

methods.name: GetCharIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a character in the barcode character set.

methods.name: GetBarSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of a barcode bar segment based on resolution and character code.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Calculates the total size of the barcode for rendering.

methods.name: GetCheckCharValue
methods.description: Calculates the checksum character for the barcode.

methods.name: DrawStart
methods.description: Draws the start code pattern for the barcode.

methods.name: DrawStop
methods.description: Draws the stop code pattern for the barcode.

methods.name: DrawCheckChar
methods.description: Draws the checksum character pattern for the barcode.

methods.name: DrawObject
methods.description: Renders the barcode onto the graphics context, optionally including text labels.
